extensionDescription.message: Places the writing area above or below the quote depending on the recipient, where Thunderbird only offers a per-identity setting.

popupNoRecipient.message: No usable recipient: the extension stays out of the way.

popupFromAddressBook.message: This recipient comes from the address book. The extension cannot read its address without an additional permission, so it does nothing.

popupNotAReply.message: This window is neither a reply nor a forward.

optionsIntro.message: A rule maps an address or a domain to a position. An exact address wins over a domain, and a domain wins over the default position.

optionsSignatureIntro.message: When the reply moves, the signature follows it if it clearly belongs to it, and stays at the bottom if it closes the message. This setting only applies when the original layout gives no clue, that is when the window opens with the reply below the quote.

optionsSignatureBottom.message: Stays at the bottom of the message

optionsInvalidKey.message: Enter a full address, or a domain starting with an at sign.

optionsInvalidFile.message: This file is not a valid rules export.
